methods.name: int resolveWorkSourceUid(int untrustedWorkSourceUid)
methods.comment:
*

This method is called in a critical path of the binder transaction. *

The implementation should never execute a binder call since it is called during a * binder transaction. * * @param untrustedWorkSourceUid The work source set by the caller. * @return the uid of the process to attribute the binder transaction to.
